about: v0.5b interface strings (OWNER: WP-C): the verse-chain duel and boss phases (view-chain.tsx); keys chain.*. Rules: notes/sa-ui.md.

chain.badge.ctx: verse-chain duel (Kathā, Hanumān): the badge at the top of the player's pick

chain.last.ctx: verse-chain duel: the label before the key sound (the last consonant of the opponent's line)

chain.prompt.en: Which line begins with this sound?
chain.prompt.sa: कस्य पादस्य आरम्भे अयं वर्णः अस्ति?
chain.prompt.ctx: verse-chain duel: the question above the three lines

chain.any.en: No line begins with this sound. Say any line!
chain.any.sa: अयं वर्णः कस्य अपि पादस्य आरम्भे न अस्ति। कम् अपि पादं वद!
chain.any.ctx: verse-chain duel: the chain resets (no heard line opens with the key), every line may follow

chain.chips.ctx: verse-chain duel: screen-reader name of the group of three line chips

chain.srTurn.en: {$who} says: {$line}. The last sound: {$key}. Which line begins with it?
chain.srTurn.sa: {$who} वदति — {$line}। अन्तिमः वर्णः — {$key}। कस्य पादस्य आरम्भे अयं वर्णः अस्ति?
chain.srTurn.ctx: verse-chain duel: screen-reader announcement of a turn ({$who} the opponent, {$line} its pāda, {$key} the key sound)

chain.srAny.en: {$who} says: {$line}. No line begins with its last sound: say any line!
chain.srAny.sa: {$who} वदति — {$line}। तस्य अन्तिमः वर्णः कस्य अपि पादस्य आरम्भे न अस्ति। कम् अपि पादं वद!
chain.srAny.ctx: verse-chain duel: screen-reader announcement when the chain resets

chain.srRight.ctx: verse-chain duel: screen reader after a miss (the right line is said)
